gen-gf-graduate-fs-ranade: Graduate has a dignified, rounded-rod build, each letter standing alone with its curves swept open. Ranade follows with a slight rubber-cord wobble in its line weight, a sans-serif whose widely spaced strokes ease the stiffness.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-syriac-: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern has tall lowercase and curve endings that keep their distance. Grandstander's flat, constant-width lines bring a bold, expressive streak to the top, and the approachable sans below keeps everything friendly and easy to follow.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-strait: Strait reads big and round, its lowercase bowls full and friendly. Grandstander's drafting-pen outlines, all drawn with one constant nib, sit above it, while the plain sans beneath carries sentences along with a relaxed, low-contrast ease.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-fs-ranade: Ranade has a slight rubber-cord give to its strokes. The monospace Libertinus Mono, with its tall pen-nib letters and a gently modulated line, is the pair's strongest quality: a structured, precise heading beside a spread-out sans-serif body.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-work-sans: Work Sans draws every line with signage-like plainness, its c tips staying well apart. Libertinus Mono is the opposite, with robust downstrokes and slender turns that look sharpest at large display sizes in a few words.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-cossette-titre: Commanding and distinctive, Metamorphous spaces its letters generously and sets its midline high. Cossette Titre, a sans-serif, nestles its letters close with open bowls, and it can be sized modestly without losing its welcoming feel.
gen-gf-noto-sans-old-persian-fs-karma: A widely parted s gives Noto Sans Old Persian its signature, along with a hefty lowercase. Karma, a classic serif, follows with terminals that finish clear of the stem and a mild swelling like worn felt marker, and it holds up at modest sizes.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-montserrat: Noto Serif Toto has ink-trace letters with soft, restrained contrast and bowls that fill the line. Montserrat gives long paragraphs a gliding feel, its oversized e and a counters and uniform sans strokes leaving the eye plenty of room.
gen-gf-nova-round-fs-rowan: Round, bold ribbons of type. Nova Round is at its strongest in commanding headings, while Rowan, a classic serif with generous openings and tempered contrast, is friendlier, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-offside-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, its x-height filling the line. Offside, with widely tracked, curve-refusing display letters, is the pair's strongest quality: expressive, commanding type above a smooth sans-serif that stays out of its way.
